name: Kathy Vanderslice
text: We went there for a recall that they had sent us in the mail. We dropped the car off Saturday morning and they called at 7am Monday morning and said it was ready. We went to pick it up after work at 2:00 pm and they told us they hadn't gotten to it yet but it wouldn't take long. We sat in the waiting area about 30 minutes. When we started to leave the car wouldn't start(no one came out to see if we needed any help) anyway we knew our battery was old so a friend drove us to Auto Zone to get a new battery. We put the new battery in and it still wouldn't start. I went back in and asked the men in the front lobby if maybe someone could test the starter, or fuel pump or something like that to see if that was the problem, he said it would be $100.00. Really?! To do something that Auto Zone, O'Reillys, or Auto Advance does for free??? He said even if it was free all the techs were busy. (Even though I saw at least 3 of them taking a smoke break). We went back out to see what else we could think of when a man asked us if anyone worked here. We said according to the man in the lobby yes. He actually yelled out "Does anyone want to sell me a car today"?  Nothing... Not one person came out to help him either. He said oh well, they just lost a sell. This is the most horrible place I have ever been to as far as customer service goes. Very rude, and extremely unprofessional. We ended up having to pull the car home after my husband came home. When we got back over there after hours, the same rude man was there, but asked my husband if he could help him in any way!!! I guess he has something against helping a woman. My husband told him no thanks, we've got this. Pitiful!!!

The rooms are nice and I enjoyed the balcony and views despite the giant spotlight.

name: Emelie Cheramie
text: First off the rooms are WAY overpriced. You get 4 waterpark wristbands per room so if you have a big family you're stuck getting another room to get the extra waterpark wristbands. The elevator banks are confusing too. Some only go up to a certain level and then you have to take a different set of elevators. The waterpark is just ok. It was fine for my little ones but if you're looking for thrill rides this is not the place to find them. I also don't like the fact thst they are now selling day passes to non guests. It definitely clogs up the already small waterpark. Rooms are clean and up to date. The best thing about this place is the game room is a whole floor and the chips and tickets on your card NEVER expire. They have a great assortment of games and prizes. Our favorite things wrre the skycoaster and ropes course.

name: A McDaniel
text: Hundreds of dollars came up missing from my clutch in my room. The only response from manager and security is that it didn’t happen. Offered me a discounted rate of $70 a night. Very poor customer service regarding this manner. I should have not left money in my room and that’s my fault. I didn’t do it purposefully. I went for a run and failed to put in safe. I stay at least 7 days per month in Biloxi. I have stayed at most of the properties in town and this is the very first time and only place I’ve ever had anything come up missing. The lack of concern is disappointing!

name: Gulf Design
text:
The first time we stayed here was a nightmare over Thanksgiving of this year! The rooms had stains on the floor, broken showers, balcony doors not locking, markings on walls were mirrors were moved around in the bathroom, markings on the walls where luggage had hit against the walls at one point, the small refrigerator never got cold, and just filthy rooms. We switched rooms three times just to find a room that was half way decent. It was a huge disappointment for my family and I! The rooms were so bad.

The staff was not the issue. The only complaint that I had with the staff was that we were never told about valet being included with the stay until we started switching rooms. I rarely valet the car, but if you don't valet the car, you will be walking a good distance with your luggage. We ended up having to park in a parking lot that was across from the resort.

After staying here this last weekend, we had a better experience with the rooms. The staff was nice like before, and the room was so much cleaner than the first stay that we did over Thanksgiving. Everything seemed to be in working order, and we made sure to valet the car this go around because we knew about it now. The only thing to consider with staying in the room that we stayed in is the amount of noise that you can hear at night from the corridors. You can hear complete conversations that people are having. This was not this noticable on the first stay we had.

We did have an issue with this noise issue because we had some drunk neighbors across from my room. At about 2 A.M. to 4 A.M., we had knocking on doors, vulgar language, people running up and down the halls, and celebrating outside our room with "Go Tigers". We had to call down to the receptionist desk to complain.

The front desk crew was very nice and under standing. They sent security and resolved the issue in a timely manner. I know this because we heard security saying "Security" with someone slurring "Man... They called security on me." After this, we had silence until their friends showed up. They were trying to find out where their other friends where. They eventually left, and we got some rest.

Would I stay here again? Possibly. The staff was great, but after the very first stay, I still have nightmares of how bad the rooms looked over the holiday. I have to say I was impressed with the security resolving the issue we had.

*Tips:
-Use the valet if you stay here. It is included with your stay.
-Eat at the restaurant/bar on the second floor in the arcade. It is better service and you get your food at a decent time. Do not eat at the restaurant on the next floor up before you get to the pool entrance.
-If you go up the escalators from the 2nd floor arcade to the next floor, you will have two restaurants. You will have Doe's Eat Place on the right and another restaurant on the left. If you go to the restaurant on the left you will wait a good amount of time just to get a table and your food. There will be empty tables, but you will not be able to sit at them. You will have to wait for a "special" table. Then when you get a table and put in an order, you will have to wait a long long long time to get your food. Do not eat here.
-If you want a quick way to get to the second floor arcade, you can use the elevator right off the walking path by the 10 min parking area. This will prevent you from walking all the way to the main entrance to use the escalators to go to the 2nd floor.

resp.text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. While I wish you had a better experience, it is feedback like this that we learn from and use to improve. We work hard to deliver an exceptional guest experience for every guest every time, and it's apparent in this case that we fell short. If you give us a chance to earn back your trust, I can assure you that we will do our best to give you the better than the best experience that so many of our guests have grown so fond of.
Sincerely,
Katy- Margaritaville Resort Biloxi Team

name: Allison Frazier Beyer
text: This resort is fun for the entire family from the babies to the grandparents. We started out in the game room zone with all our kids ages 10-16 years old. There are games for even toddlers. All kinds of games as well as a zip line, obstacle course, seated zip line roller coaster. On the 10th floor where you check-in, there is a nice coffee house and a bar with very comfortable seating areas. This is a non-smoking building but there are balcony/patio outdoor areas for smokers to sit and relax while taking a smoke break. The pool area is very nice and clean. It is salt water. There is a nice tall slide, a lazy river, a pool with seating ledges around the edge of the pool. The pool also has a swim-up bar. There is also a toddler area with fun stuff for the babies and seating around this area. They also have a walk-up area to order food and drinks with an outdoor area with tables and chairs to eat at. Or you can go into the restaurant for dinning and a little break from the heat. They have plenty of recliner seating around the pool area, but there is no shade so bring your sunscreen. Towels are provided upon entering but must be left upon leaving the pool area so best to bring a couple of your own towels to wrap up or a bathing suit cover. The pool does not allow personal floats but they do have floats for the lazy river. I do wish they would be more vigilant about stopping people from removing the floats from the water and hoarding them till they decided to get back in the water. The rooms were nice and clean. And, our room had GREAT air-conditioning with a beautiful view of the Gulf. The only complaint I and many others have is there is not enough elevators!! The wait time for the ELEVATORS is very long and a very slow process especially on check-out day. So be patient and do NOT get in a hurry.

text:
Never again will I visit this place, horrible valet staff and Director of Security Dewayne Pirtile. The valet staff damaged my vehicle. On Saturday, the 10th day of November I valet parked my 2016 Jeep Wrangler. When I arrived at the resort, I did not have a low or flat tire because my Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) light was not on, nor did I observe a flat tire. Upon Departure from the resort I, observed that the rear passenger tire was completely flat.

The valet attendant drove my Jeep on a completely flat tire. I explained to the staff when I dropped my Jeep off with them, that my TPMS was not on and nor did I have a low/flat tire. The tire was most likely punctured in their parking garage.

However, let’s say the puncture occurred off their property and the tire leaked down in their garage. It is obvious when my Jeep has a flat tire because the vehicle will be leaning. Additionally, when driving right away one would notice that the tire is flat by the sound and feel.

With the attendant driving my Jeep on a flat tire, it could no longer be repaired because the attendant caused further damage by driving it. I asked to speak to a supervisor, so I could make an official report. However, there was no supervisor and Valet Attendant Rashaad took some basic information from and told me that the Director of Security Dewayne Pirtle would not be in until Monday.

I contacted Dewayne on Monday the 12th day of November to follow up with the incident.  When I, spoke to Dewayne, he had no idea about the incident. Obviously, Rashaad failed to report the incident to Dewayne. Dewayne stated that he would get back with me later in the day, but he never did.

I contacted Dewayne on Tuesday the 13th day of November to follow up again. Dewayne informed me that the General Manager stated that they would not take responsibility of replacing my tire since the attendant did not observe it was flat.

I’m very aggravated with the resort not wanting to take responsibility for their actions.  Dewayne & Rashaad were not very helpful and failed to do their jobs.

name: Austin Smith
text: I was excited about our stay at Margaritaville, when we arrived we were pleased with valet and check-in. The resort only had 4 elevators for guest room access. Since they only had 4 elevators we always had to wait no less than 20 minutes to go anywhere. Once we got checked into the room, we decided to check out the water playground area, it was crowded but my daughter loved it. I tried to get a drink at the swim up bar, there was only one bartender. Fast forward to night,we ate at Does Eat Place. I made a reservation for 6 people, we arrived and they were not busy. We ordered our food, two steaks to split and 3 sides, we waiting close to two hours before we got our food. We also ordered room service, a coke and slice of cheese cake, waiting 45 mins before I called to check on it. I was told, "I'm sorry sir we just served our last slice of cheese cake", "click", needless to say we didn't get our drink either. Fast forward to check out day, we called for a bellman for a cart to get our luggage, I was told 20-25 mins. We sat around for 40-45 mins, so I called again to check on it, I was told, "I'm sorry sir, we didn't have you on the list stating you needed one. I will have one right up". Needless to say after an hour of waiting and calling twice we finally got a cart. Overall our stay wasn't worth $300 a night, so I most likely will not be back.

wifi cannot keep up and I had to turn off wifi to access internet
The walls are paper thin so you need to bring ear plugs and hope you have good neighbors
Summary
So you want a place to take the kids-this is your place
You want a little down time and quiet-go elsewhere

name: Beatamaria Leiser
text: We were there for entertainment only. Originally we were going to go to the Crawfish festival for rides, etc. But the prices were astronomical for our very large group. We've been to Big Play, which is good & fun, but we wanted something new & exciting. This place was great! I'm comparing it mostly to Big Play since they're the closest competitor. It had these high tech virtual games to keep the kids active, a scenic rock climbing wall, a very cool ropes-climbing-flying type course the kids couldn't get enough of & then a ride that I think is supposed to be like a seated zip line- I dunno. But it was all great! Lots of great arcade games to choose from, a bowling alley, & all the other basics you see today & everything was in working order with plenty of space to move around! Only downfalls I'd say is that everything's a bit pricey in comparison, like drinks you have to get at the bar, or you're not getting many tickets from your games, nor should you expect to get much from your tickets because the prizes aren't cheap! That's one thing I'll give Big Play, you get your tickets a-plenty, & no matter how many you have everyone is going home a winner! They've got great prizes to make every child/adult happy... No lollipop for you, you get a stuffed animal! But you might be getting what you pay for. It's very nice in there & it has a variety you don't get to see often. It's definitely worth goin back to. & If you're worker with tighter budgets can go to Big Play & use Margaritaville as the special place for every other time, bdays, etc. Personally, though, one thing I do wish that they'd make skee ball bigger for adults to play without breaking a hip, instead of these itty bitty little set ups they do for kids. I've been to plenty of arcades decked out with a variety of sizes, it's possible. Who takes the kids there, people?

text:
Well I made it here & just a few days shy of the one year anniversary.

Pros:
>Great valet service
>Love the water park
>Massive Amusement area called "Escape Family Entertainment Center"
>Cost of amusement rides/games is fair>
>Love the sitting chairs that adorn the valet area; great for lounging
>Great toiletries i.e. mouthwash, lotion, shampoo, conditioner and the like
>Pool/"waterpark" access is restricted to guest ONLY
>No fee to enter the ESCAPE FAMILY ENTERTAINMENT CENTER

Cons:
>Difficult to know where the entrance is as it is located in the parking area
>Would like to see more shaded area on the water parks
>Cost of rooms
>The rooms are LESS THAN AVERAGE, old decor; sub-par carpentry,
>$100 damage deposit
>Balconies had a ledge that you have to step up toby pass; that's a potential safety hazard
>Need more elevators as we had to wait for several to pass before one came with room
>Great family friendly place for the kids
>Loved the swim up bar

All in all, it was nice to go, but for the cost of the room, & the very condition/appearance of the room,  I wouldn't go again.  Save yourself $250 by taking your kid to a water park elsewhere, stay in another hotel in the area & then visit the ESCAPE FAMILY ENTERTAINMENT CENTER, easy peasy!!!!!

name: Mike Dunaway
text: It is a giant arcade for kids but is nice

resp.text:
Hi, Mike!
We are glad you enjoyed your visit, but we are so much more than just an arcade! Our family entertainment center is 55,000 square feet of fun, featuring over 150 arcade games and three attractions- the sky tikes ropes course, 48 foot volcano rock wall, and indoor cloud coaster. We offer three restaurant options: the Landshark Bar and Grill, Margaritaville café, and Doe's Eat Place, as well as our own on-site coffee shop and five bar locations. If you're looking for something sweet check out our Sweet Shack for Dippin' Dots, soft serve, and hand-crafted milkshakes. Bring home the island charm by shopping in our two retails stores. Don't forget our hotel guests have access to our rooftop water playground! Bask in picturesque views of Deer Island while you relax in our pool complete with swim up bar, or take on the challenge of our balancing flip flops obstacle course. Race down our two water slides or make a splash in our children's splash pad area, or simply waste away floating through the 450 foot lazy river. We hope you'll come back and see all we have to offer!

text: i am a regular here and have been for a while. the hotels rooms are nice. the restaurants are better than most. the casino is just like all the others. i would go to four stars but i feel that the island view doesn't appreciate locals. its not so much as what they do, its what they don't do.

name: Dan Avallone
text: Love this place. Service and staff are fantastic.  Great place to staff and play

name: andrew vigueira
text: Clean, open, non smoking casino with great view of the beach area. Nice sandwich shop with indoor and outdoor seating.  Steakhouse also. staff was very courteous and friendly.

name: Rebecca Voyles
text: I don't go to casinos often. We went to the buffet which was great. Our waiter was very friendly and on point. The casino was fine. Players club staff was very sweet. Security was pleasant as well as the dealers we came in contact with.

name: Libia Brockhoeft
text: Great time there.  Very clean.  Security makes sure that mask is on. Buffet was good but not great.  Some employees were polite.  Server was very attentive.  One employee who was serving fried chicken was not customer friendly.  More sanitizing stations were needed in the gaming areas.  Bathrooms were very clean and well supplied.

name: George Johnson
text: Nice place to go I enjoyed myself, friendly folks nice customer service people, good place to go relax and have fun

name: Rose Myers
text: My first time there since covid.  It was nice and clean.  People did their best to social distance.  The staff there was nice and helpful.  You might even win a little money.

name: Beau Wall
text: This is my favorite coast casino. It has the best payouts in my experience. I really like the smoke free dude even though I vape. The smoke free side has huge windows that overlook the port of Gulfport which is a pretty nice view! I'm pretty sure it's the only casino with windows lol

name: Pat B
text: Easy access, Plenty of parking, Beach side casino in non-smoking, Shore side allows smoking but it wasn't overwhelming. The buffet is very good, and very fairly priced for lunch. Lots of variety: soups & gumbo's, salads, seafood, Asian, Italian, Southern, Carved Meats, Pizza & a large variety of deserts.

name: Melinda Homan
text: I love this Casino and Hotel! The staff are super friendly! They have put forth great efforts to help protect everyone that comes inside. The restaurant staff are great! The lady that took our to-go order was the sweetest! The food was great and they even gave us extra condiments without being asked! The slots are up to date with the newest slots! I couldn't decide what to play 1st. We didn't stay at the hotel this time but in the past they were great! Really nice rooms and bathrooms that have been remodeled and they even have a new wing that was built a couple of years ago that would blow your mind! They always give really good free play and comps verses other casinos! They have so many amenities and things to do as well! Highly recommend you try it at least once!

name: Meaghan Holsen
text: The staff really goes out of their way to make you feel appreciated here. Island view also gives the best/most free play! I love the machines; there are so many to choose from. The only things I don’t like is the smell of the hallways in the hotels. I suppose it is the guests themselves that I smell and maybe island view can’t do much about that... but all the halls smell like someone who hasn’t showered. I still give 5 stars though!

name: Lashonda Kennedy
text: Everytime I make reservations at the casino hotel.. All direct mail offers are based on qualified rated play which is calculated by the proper use of your players’ card. Offers may vary, depending upon day of the week, holidays and seasonality. View play is not calculated as part of your qualified rated play. Therefore, each time you visit and only use your offer, your rated play is affected. Based on how often you visit, it may take up to 60 days for your offers to change.
Chris D.
Telecommunications Specialist.

That includes hotel rooms, restaurants, and obviously the casino floor. We made this decision in response to COVID19 requirements which allow us to be open but only at 50% of our max capacity. This decision was made to allow guests that receive complimentary offers the opportunity to use them. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you. You can stay up-to-date on any changes put in place due to COVID19 on our frequently asked questions page on our website.
-Chris D.

There were not many table games. This place is definitely worth checking out.

text: Island View is a locally owned casino and they show love for the local crowd.  Their player's club rewards are great. They are very accommodating to needs, just ask. The coffee shop not only has wonderful coffee with many "fixings," but the display cases are filled with the most scrumptious of treats.  From a quick breakfast muffin to the most decadent brownie ever every taste bud will find something satisfying anytime day or night. The only con of Island View is the pools have been shut down for under 21.  Not sure if this will change after new construction is finished.

Zero stars for this casino. I had a most disappointing experience with this casino tonight. After having a break even experience  on the slots, I proceeded to leave the casino. Because I had a few drinks and was not completely sober, security followed me out to my vehicle. I did not cause any scene or disruption with anybody within the casino. I figured the best thing to do is to fall asleep in my vehicle. However' within two minutes of entering my vehicle, Gulfport police arrived on the scene, and my keys were not in the ignition, yet security personnel lied blatantly and said otherwise. I did not try to drive away, yet they lied and said they saw me put my keys into the ignition. A) I have tinted windows, B) This was an egregrious misappropriation of facts. Secondly, I found out that my tier point balance now reflected a new member and not two levels up as an ultimate  member that my card reflects. I would highly discourage ever stepping foot into this casino if you ever decide to have an alcoholic beverage. I am appalled, shocked, and highly disappointed by the casino and how they handled this tonight.

Went to court last Wednesday on this egregious charge, found not guilty, and represented myself through the whole ordeal. If I can figure out how to post a picture on comments, I will show proof.

name: Chris Crow
text: The Island View is on the beach. One side of the casino is on the South side of Hwy 90 (directly on the beach). The other side is directly across Hwy 90 on the North side of Hwy 90. The two buildings are connected by a breezeway to avoid walking across Hwy 90 or driving across to the other side. Shuttle services are available by this casino as well. During many Gulf Coast events and Music festivals the Island View Casino provides FREE shuttle buses to transport guests to and from these events. Shuttles have air, heat, tinted windows and spacious seating. The shuttles are slightly larger than a van and not nearly as large as a school bus. This is one of the smaller casinos on the MS Gulf Coast, but its growing and has all of the amenities of the large casinos. There's a hotel, spa and pool for guests. It has several restaurants with a variety of foods with a good range of prices depending on what you want to spend. There's a small club/bar that's off the casino floor. This club/bar area is also where the entertainment is set up. Sometimes the entertainment/celebrities/bands are well known on a national level. Other times there are artists/bands that are well known locally on the Gulf Coast and surrounding areas. There are several bars on the actual casino floor conveniently spaced out. One of these bars is a sports bar with several TVs showing games or sporting events year round. The casino has a nice variety of games that feature a variety of bets available for the slot machines. There are plenty of table games - all the ones you will see in larger casinos. They have card tournaments here as well. The casino is located in Gulfport, but in an area that doesn't generally have heavy traffic issues. Locals enjoy this casino very much. However, the hotel is always busy with guests staying from out of town. Being locals we enjoy this casino very much. All staff are friendly and helpful. Bathrooms are clean. All food areas are clean. We've even stayed in the hotel a few times and it's very nice. Easily comparable to hotel rooms like the Hard Rock or Beau Rivage. Highly recommend!

text: Here's a lesson in common sense for the promotions manager: If you have a similar drawing to your sister casino that's 7 miles away, then don't run the same promo on the same day. Do your 20 times entries on Monday and your drawing on Friday and have your sister casino do their 20x entries on Tuesday and their drawing on Saturday or vice versa. This doubles your chances of getting repeat business, unless your strategy is to send this business across the street on Friday to your competitors casino. By the way promotional funds are to attract business not to give free money out to people who are already gambling there anyway.

name: Melissa Jones
text:
The staff members are very friendly and helpful. The king beds have memory foam mattress. The pool is indoors and open year round. (Heated in the winter). There is also a fitness room and an award winning golf course and an  RV park. There are 3 food options here. The grill which offers sandwiches and salads and snack items, the buffet, which is awesomeoffers prime rib and crab legs on Friday and Saturday nights. The buffet also has a 55¢ senior breakfast (aged 50+) Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday and a 99¢ breakfast on Friday for everyone. The steakhouse is out of this world.  You can eat a la cart or get their $19.99 special which is more than one can eat. I recommend the lettuce wedge and the French onion soup. Superb.
The gaming floor is fabulous wth hundreds of slots and table games. There are two bars on the gaming floor (drinks are free) and live entertainment on the weekends. If you are a non drinker, as I am, you will find two complimentary soda fountains that also serve fresh coffee.  I love this place.

text:
Some good. Mostly bad.

Not someone who leaves negative reviews often, but. I mean.

Good - service, timeliness, ambience, cleanliness, drinks, bread, Range Rattlers ♥️

Bad - FOOD. Not good at all. Made worse by the price, since you expect more. Steak was average, chicken was tacky, rice was salty a over buttered, soup was weird/grainy/some how bland, salad was drowning in dressing. I’ve had Salt Grass before in Houston, it was definitely better.

name: Donna Benard
text: I've been to many Saltgrass Steakhouses in Texas prior to this visit.  It was good but the menu is more limited than the Texas locations.  I got Chicken Fried Steak with country gravy to the side, otherwise the crunch gets soggy.  I remembered this being so good. In this case overall it was good but not as good. There was an end of the steak that bent and doubled which allowed part of the steak to be uncooked batter in the middle.  Not good. The thin portion that didn't have uncooked dough was good.  My friend got the Chicken Laredo which has traditionally been good there and this one didn't disappoint. We did start with the range rattlers which is a must do at this restaurant. For those not aware it is a very large shrimp stuffed into a jalapeno with jack cheese, then battered and deep fried. A most excellent choice.  Also having 22 oz beer on draft is great. We chose Blue Moon as always excellent. The disappointment was I felt it was all to rushed for us by this waiter. He was alright but I like when a waiter comes back to check on you and see how things are.  That did NOT happen with this server so I just had to sit and stew over the batter being raw.  He said he'd let someone know but I know he didn't.  It was still nice though to know I have a place to go when I need a little bit of my former Texas life.

name: Dick Jones
text: The chicken fried chicken and center-cut sirloin were excellent.  The cheese fries are more like potato chunks more than fries and are a bit of an acquired taste.  Our waiter, Christian was a pretty cool guy.   We will likely be back to feed our faces again.

name: Melissa Gilbert
text:
I only gave them 3 stars because we opted for carry out because of the 30 to 45 minute wait to be seated for dine in and we didn't receive all of our food. Originally a Texas girl so I had high expectations of the chain and was mildly disappointed in the food. Price was median at $70 for 3 meals. You get one side choice and a salad but they didn't include our salads, first disappointment. When we opened our to-go containers we were thrilled at first glance it looked really good. However I would not recommend the Chicken Fried Steak. It looks awesome but it's mostly breading, our second disappointment. We also got Chicken Lerado but we're disappointed once again that the toppings were hiding a rather small piece of chicken. Flavors were good on all of it though so that part saved the experience to some degree.

So if you want to take your guest to a place for the atmosphere this is a good choice. If you are seriously hungry might not be the best place to go. Be prepared to wait however and go early because the stop seating at 8:30, with the wait time to be seated at minimum 30 minutes.

name: Paul A. Bennett
text:
I took my mother for a pre-Valentine dinner at the newish Saltgrass Steakhouse in Biloxi, MS. It is up off the ground so be ready to use the elevator or traverse up a couple of flights of stairs. We showed up early (1715ish) for dinner so our wait was under 10 minutes. They use a texting system and ask for your phone number to contact you when the table is ready. We were seated and Oscar, our waiter, took our drink orders. We asked alot of questions, which he answered or steered us towards his favorites, and settled on the Seafood Fondue for an appetizer, a 22oz Cowboy Ribeye for myself, and a Mushroom Smothered Filet Mignon for the young lady. Everything came out and was timed very well. My only complaint was my steak, ordered Medium rare to Medium, was rare and not bleeding at all when it came to the table. I debated on commenting, but after Oscar returned to the table he looked at it and thought she was quite rare. Anyhow, I would suggest aiming a little overcooked when ordering that hoss of a ribeye. A few minutes later it returned, with managerial service, and it was as I wanted it. The Fondue was superb, salads were fresh, the brussel sprouts were shaved and cooked with bacon and onions (also superb), and all was very enjoyable.

Dessert, my favorite part.....

TRY THE PECAN AND BOURBON GLAZED BREAD PUDDING TOPPED WITH ICE CREAM. It is amazing.

Our experience at The Saltgrass Steakhouse was wonderful and we will be returning to try some other menu items. I may just go for the dessert.

text: I suggest to make reservations for Salt Grass because the tables fill up really quick. The chairs are comfortable and the music is especially if you like country music. I was lucky and got a waitress by the name of Jasmine. She was spot on with checking in on us, and ensuring the food was coming as soon as it was ready to be served. The steaks were cooked perfectly to medium rare. The appetizers were also amazing. The Seafood Fondue I believe is what it was called was great! They also serve bread and butter complimentary. The cheesecake was phenomenal! It had white chocolate drizzled on top and I didn’t have the strawberries put on. The crust was really thick and tasted amazing! My wife ordered an alcoholic drink I don’t remember what it was exactly but she was very happy on how it wasn’t watered down. My wife and I are definitely coming back and I highly recommend them!

text: Stopped in for takeout. The hostess was friendly and helpful to start then things deteriorated from there. Had to wait nearly an hour for my order which I sort of understand they were busy with a 30 min wait. Ok whatever. Then when the girl brought out my order (along with several other orders (kinda weird) and read off the contents it sounded wrong because of shrimp being added for an extra $9 She then  took it back to make sure it was mine. She promptly brought the same order back and tried to convince me that was how I ordered it. Telling me I asked for shrimp. I know what I ordered. I never once mentioned shrimp. That wasn't what upset me though. It was her attitude towards me through it all when all I was trying to do was make sure it was correct. After all it was an $84 supper for two. So finally I said ok that's fine my girlfriend likes shrimp lets go with it. We get back to our room only to find out there is no shrimp and the food is atrocious. The ribs were a heap of burnt fat. The steak was cold. Tough and fatty. The potato was half baked as im sure the cook was. But hey, the salad was good.That doesn't require any culinary skill. We've Been looking forward to going to Saltgrass for quite some time. Now, its never again. What an overcharged rudely exchanged disappointment.

text: I worked at Del Frisco's steakhouse, so I may just be being picky. But the service we got was ... Bad. We waited about an hour for a table for 3 for my friend's birthday. When we walked in to see what was taking so long, we watched a family of 4 walk right in and be seated immediately. Then we got seated right next to the kitchen. When I asked for a Sprite and water the waiter said "oh you're one of those people" and yes I 100% am someone who drinks water. Sorry I guess? For a Saturday night I expect servers to be on their A game, and this was no where near that. The food was just okay, the presentation (for a steakhouse) was horrible. However,  the rest of us ordered the steak and shrimp and we didn't.  We were shocked to find that there was gristle all the way through the steaks for all of us. It's not a good thing when you must use your napkin to discreetly spit out many pieces of your steak because of this.  The service was slow. This can be looked over but paying the amount that we did will send us to other restaurants. This was our favorite restaurant.

name: jeremy ellzey
text:
*UPDATE*
9 Aug 2020. Still have not spoke with anyone. They have twice asked me for my contact information in a seemingly canned response to negative reviews. I provided my information and received no contact.
14 June 2020. Still have not been contacted back by anyone.
We ordered from here on April 30 2020.  One meal was completely missing. We paid for delivery through Waitr. I had to drive over to the restaurant anyway, because they disconnected their phones at 7:15 because they were closing 8:30. When I arrived I spoke with the manager, Mr. Bourg. he informed me that the meals get checked by 3 people before they leave..  then he blamed the whole thing on Waitr and said we should go to them for a refund. Keep in mind, Saltgrass prepared the meals, stapled the bags shut with the receipt on them Waitr just grabs them and delivers them. Waitr didn't miss here Saltgrass did. Beside the missing meal, the other meals were completely wrong with things that we did not order missing items and just bad food... one of the meals was steak and shrimp, for some reason they put gravy and onions on the steak, (not requested and not part of the meal) so we ended up with soggy fried shrimp that were sitting in gravy and everything tasted like onions.. the kids hamburger was completely raw... not rare, raw. and my medium ribey was well done shoe leather.  Mr. Bourg basically said he would give me the missing meal and that's it. He made no attempt to correct the other deficiencies, and if I wanted a refund I would have to go through Waitr (this had nothing to do with them). I never asked for a refund.. but the fact of the matter is every penny spent on this meal was a total waste. Mr. Bourg could not be bothered to help me much that night so he did give me his card, I waited 30 minutes to get the missing meal and he said to contact him the following day which was May 1st. I emailed Mr Bourg, no response. I then went on to their corporate website, and filled out their questionnaire. They were supposed to call me back, that never happened. I have since called twice left two messages, no response. I have not been and will not be rude to anyone, I just feel that most people expect more of this place and should get the value of their money. we have eaten at Saltgrass before and been satisfied, I do not have an unrealistic expectation of what to expect from a restaurant like Saltgrass but I do have a minimum expectation of correct to order and good food, and it should at least be better than Denny's. I gave them every opportunity before leaving this review.

text:
I was pleasantly surprised by Saltgrass. I'm don't eat steak very often, but when I do, I prefer it to be a quality one.

The service here was very good, they seated is quickly, ordered our drinks and appetizers, and shortly afterwards ordered our steaks.

For the drinks, the margaritas are good, and the Tito's tea was good, although a bit sweet for my taste.

I had surf and turf with BBQ shrimp. The steak was cooked wonderfully, which I had ordered medium-rare, and was flavorful and tender. The BBQ were very good, and if I have the chance again I could imagine just ordering them instead.

text: Salt grass is an awesome place with wonderful food, but if you want a truly truly enjoyable time while you're here sit at the bar and Enjoy Beau's service and drinks. Will be back as often as possible!!!

Salad was cold and crispy.
The porterhouse is large and tender.
Cooked perfectly.
A companion had chicken fried steak. It was the largest chicken fried steak I have ever seen. Looked like a barn door it was so huge.
My wife had Tbone. Not much smaller than the porterhouse.
Good service. An adjustment had to be made to the bill. Done without complaint.
BTW. We got a military discount. Ask for it.

text: One of the finest steak houses on the gulf coast. Atmosphere and staff were very helpful and friendly and professional, food was excellent. We'd seen a lot of hype for this place and after going, not sure why. I honestly prefer Outback or Texas Roadhouse, or would rather pay barely any more to go to one of the high end steakhouses down here.

text: They rock the steak house ambience. The drinks were tasty, but week. The Seafood dip was awesome! The Chicken Tortilla soup was too salty.  The steaks were good. The desserts (cheesecake and bread pudding were both tasty and enough for 2 to share.

text: From our experience on  Thursday dinner, the overall experience did not offer a value. Our meals were simple orders of grilled chicken sandwich and chicken tenders, but took 47 minutes from order to table. Draft local beverages were high in comparison to other similar restaurants.  The food portions were average at best, but were higher priced in comparison to other  locations in my opinion. Although the location did not appear too busy, service was slow with some mistakes on our order requests for sides and condiments.  For an order that cost $145 to serve four people with the level of customer service received, the experience was disappointing for us.

text: The food was excellent.  The service was fine.  We had a large group.  The service was almost more than we could ask for during the whole meal.

name: Katrina Newell
text: Do online reservations!!!!!! We went for the first time and because of doing an online reservation we didn't have to wait long for a table. The place was full and empty tables didn't stay empty long. Due to the busyness it took our server a little bit to get to us. We ordered the chips and dip appetizer. Our steaks seemed to take awhile to cook, so we ate the entire appetizer and still had time to wait for our entrees. I will take the busyness of the restaurant in consideration, but when tables they came in and ordered after us were already getting similar orders, it makes you a little angry. My server took time getting refills and our entrees. I will give it another chance, again due to the busyness of the evening. Maybe it will be better.

name: Brittany Lohman
text: Food was fantastic. Sat at the bar waiting for our table to order drinks, we were not acknowledged but we saw they both were busy. We did get a round before we were called to our table  Server seemed to be a little new. We were offered another tables food order and then a drink order. Table points were off (as another server ran our food and ended up auctioning them off). We are in the industry and just offer our views as points as training. All the staff was very friendly. Ladies bathroom could have used a little more attention even though it was close to closing, 2 out of the 3 stalls were left with no toilet paper. We understand the restaurant is fairly new and we know hiccups have to be worked out. We will be back!

name: N M
text: I had the ribeye shared plate with coconut shrimp it was divine!! Elias was the best server. I hope you get him.

name: AP

I totally was not expecting the cream cheese and was blown away.  The steak, however, was not that good.  It was just tougher than I'd expect from a place of this caliber.  I'd definitely come back though.

name: Tonya Whitten
text:
When this place first opened the food was amazing! But now it’s just mediocre. The asparagus is always so so thin, limp and soggy, same with their green beans. The Mac and cheese is always either under cooked or over cooked. We’ve had the steaks that were burnt and the chicken was dry.
I was so impressed by this restaurant the first two times we went, except for the vent dripping on my head, but that was handled.
Anyway, I really doubt I’ll be going back. Paying $60 for two meals that weren’t worth eating is hardly a relaxing night out.

text: 2nd Visit! This time we got there a little early around 4:00 p.m. on a Saturday after one of the grandkid's pageant programs and it wasn't crowded, although it did get more so as we were eating. Noticed a lot of the crowd coming in early were seniors, probably from the casino.Seniors older than us that is! Host & servers were very friendly and attentive & service was quick. We started with the crab cakes appetizer. Considering I grew up here in Biloxi, I was skeptical, but I have to say they were beyond expectations. Lots of crab meat & nicely seasoned. Delicious! My husband had the Surf & Turf ribeye, with BBQ stuffed shrimp, which is a bacon wrapped shrimp stuffed with a cream cheese jalapeno blend. I tried one & they were delicious! I got the Pat's Ribeye again, 12 ounce, cooked perfectly medium rare & "smothered" (caramelized onions, mushrooms & herb butter). The only complaint I have is one big string of the onion was inedible - someone didn't trim that onion well before slicing! Not that big of a deal. We both had salads, mine with Thousand Island & his with Ranch - dressings are homemade there at the restaurant they tell us & were delicious. Salads were very fresh & cold. I had the garlic mashed potatoes side & they are delicious & loaded with garlic. He had fries. The iced tea is even excellent, though I also ordered a side cocktail. They have quite a few specialties - I tried the Southside - Jameson Irish Whiskey, fresh lime juice & cucumber. It was very refreshing & I really enjoyed it! Can't wait to try some of the others too. No desserts this time. We were full & had enough left for another meal the next day. Great food, great experience & looking forward to another trip soon!

text:
My wife and I decided to try this new place for lunch today, we parked underneath the building which was shaded and covered which would be good for a rainy day and the elevator is conveniently located underneath there as well. We were quickly greeted and Seated at a table as soon as we walked in and got to sit next to the Bison head mounted on the wall. I will note that it is strange that a Texas restaurant did not carry diet dr. Pepper but they have regular dr. Pepper they also have Diet Coke and Coke Zero for those who do want to drink diet. The potato soup and garden salad were both flavorful and filling along with the beer bread and butter. My wife had the chopped steak with macaroni and cheese as her side, she said the steak was extremely dry even with the gravy it didn't help and would not get that again, the mac and cheese was creamy and flavorful with a slight Taste of queso so it's not traditional mac and cheese.

I had Pat's ribeye 12 oz and specifically asked for it to be cooked medium well to well done with very little to no pink if possible. Our server assured me that she would tell the cook just exactly the way I liked it to be done. I also asked for the steak fries for my side, when the plate was brought out I noticed that the steak was a fairly good-sized but was extremely thin it was very thinly cut and the steak fries we're not actually what you would typically think as steak fries, they were potato wedges that were cut and then deep-fried with the skins on. Although the steak did not produce any blood it was fairly pink from edge to edge no matter where I cut into the steak so it was not cooked to order and unbelievably incorrectly cooked even with it being such a thin cut of steak. I would like to claim this as growing pains for a new restaurant however this seems to be the norm at every steak restaurant I go to. The server was very polite and taking care of us and agree to let the manager know and they removed the cost of my meal from the bill without hesitation.

text:
The Promenade itself has a good selection of stores/ fast/quick food restaurants.  Biggest issue I have with the area is it is very congested.  There is tons of space on the South side of I-10 where a mall was suppose to go in 10 years ago, but it sits empty.  Recommend moving the higher congested stores South (i.e. Chick A filet and Olive Garden). At a minimum move some of the congestion closer to Zaxby's.  The whole middle strip of stores in addition to the one's previously mentioned (Buffalo Wild Wings, Starbucks, Smoothie Place, Shoe Station)...open this area up and redesign the parking areas.
Additionally, the location for Lowe's.  It is dangerous and unsafe pulling in and out of parking lot.  I would also eliminate the access road by Wendy's and Ruby Tuesday and redesign entering form the Whataburger entrance to get to all the areas in the back corner...this may not be the best location either, but the area of Lowes/Wendy's and on top off that the busy intersection catty corner just adds to the congestion.

name: EyesWideOpen aka Pam
text: This is one of, if not the most historic landmarks, in Biloxi, MS. The atmosphere in several of the rooms, is splendid and you will not find a more friendly staff in town at a very busy restaurant! Always call ahead tho, to make reservations because they are always a packed house from Mon-Sat, mainly for supper and closed on Sundays. The seafood is so fresh, it cones from local shrimpers and fishermen which helps our local economy! All my years living here on the Gulf Coast, I've never been with any one  person or a dinner  party that has sent food back, or complained about their food. As I said the atmosphere is quite elegant and private in some rooms and more family style and more brightly lit in other rooms, it really is whichever you prefer and as long as you let them know ahead of time, they have always accommodated us. Mr. Mahoney himself will come out and tries to greet as many people as he can, table by table. It's a great historic place with old town Biloxi, written all over it, and absolutely 5 star quality food to take your out of town guests. Dress, to be quite honest, is nice casual, I would say, that you don't have time wear your Sunday best, unless your occasion calls for it, and this is a beach town, so, as long as you are not in a string bikini, ha, I'm sure you will be welcome! Oh and there is boutique type shopping in the courtyard, as well, with great views of Biloxi for taking family and friend photos for your memories!

text:
This is a nice outlet mall located about an hour south of Hattiesburg. And despite what the name may imply, there are some stores where one can affordability shop (VF Outlet for example, among others).

Social distancing was enforced and masks were worn by everyone within all of the stores I went in and passed by. This outlet mall is definitely comprable (if not better) than many of the other outlet malls in Mississippi. One could drive here from out of town and the trip would be completely worthwhile.

Plus, the coast is just a stone's throw away.

text:
This is a phenomenal collection of outlets, both on quantity and quality. I would highly recommend making a day of it. They had plenty of parking, a food court, and public restrooms available.

Cream of the crop: Disney, Vera Bradley, and the Kitchen Collection.

The Kitchen Collection had some super cute stuff, like cat spatulas for $2 apiece.

Vera Bradley had very good prices on their bags, relatively speaking. Still super pricey, but much more doable.

Disney... Oh, boy! It was a magical experience. They had AMAZING prices, super friendly staff, and it was just plain *fun*. We spent a long time in there, and surprisingly not much money considering how much we bought! I got an adorable baby princess lunch bag, and a subtle Minnie Mouse sun hat. No matter your age, I recommend this store!

name: Neil Richardson
text: This place has a great atmosphere but they lack speed and stock. They run out of liquor and food too quickly. It was a Tuesday and by the time they were going to cook my meal, after more than 20 minutes came and told me they were out. So I had to make a new order and wait another 20 minutes.  They had live music which was awesome and made up for the bad! Everyone should check this place out at least once. I will not go back but it was worth one time!

resp.text: Sorry we were out of the order Neil.  We want you to come back.  We were super busy that night and this was clearly our mistake.  Please let us make it right!  We have 45 beers on tap and a wide variety of specialty cocktails and wine.  Sometimes we make mistakes.  When we do I want to make it right.  I'm glad you had a good time and I assure you we will do better next time!

text: My grandson was treating me to a meal. Chose this spot because of the band playing that was the best thing they had to offer. A young lady came over with fries we were surpised that they may have these like some places have complimentary  chips and dip. Then rude  waitress came over and asked if we ordered those we said no she gave us a dirty look informed our waiter we could eat them but we would have to pay for them? God bless our waiter he took care of it he was as surprised as we were. We both ordered salads very dry had to get extra dressing but the music was good.

resp.text: Awww.  Thanks.

name: Scott Nina
text: The owner is or was Arturo Barajas. I ate gumbo at your restaurant and had a glass of water. I am reviewing your gumbo and your water. I did not like your gumbo. The water was okay, cool and refreshing. You sir, are a very snide, snarky and crass individual when it comes to replying to google reviewers. Your replies to the reviews of Mosaic Restaurant are ridiculous in tone and manner. I think you have poor people skills. I definitely will not ever visit again as I have lost any desire to support Mosaic Restaurant.

resp.text:
The owner is not Arturo.  .

Please note that this reviewer based his review on one glass of water and a bowl of homemade gumbo.  That is the entirety of the review.  Further, he initially gave us two stars but amended his review when I logically pointed out how ridiculous it is to review a restaurant with a large menu, 45 draft beers, and over 30 crafted cocktails based on the small sample size.

name: Sara Robertson
text: The service was horrible. I am generally forgiving of rough service if a place is busy especially when there is live music I understand that it can be a bit more hectic. However, we were seated and ignored for roughly 20 minutes. We had to flag down a waiter to even be waited on. My friend had to go to the bar themselves to get a second round of drinks. There were time periods were no wait staff could be found for about 10/15 minutes. I saw one waiter ignore tables completely. Again, I’m forgiving if the place is packed but it wasn’t packed this particular night, the entire inside seating area had maybe 10 people in it and the outside area was maybe 2/3 capacity. I only give a 2 star rating because the food and drinks were actually very good.

resp.text: Hi Sara.  Sorry for the rough service experience.  Please make sure to ask for a manager next time.  We have bad days every once in a while.  May I ask what day you came in so that we can determine what the problem was?  Thanks and have a great day.

text: Initial service was spotty, but odd time. However, order anything with the pulled pork on it. We had the Cuban and a corned beef sandwich. Corned beef was a bit different but okay. Would not order again. But the Cuban, despite not being a traditional Cubano, was delicious. That pulled pork? Would be good on a flip flop. Seriously good grub. Mojito was first rate too.

resp.text: Hey Gene. Sorry about the service. We were a bit understaffed. Pork is really good. Thanks for hanging in there.

name: Erik Schweiss
text:
I used to visit the mosaic all the time but it seems to have changed a lot for the worse. I had one of the worst burgers I have ever had for lunch. Will not be going back

Edit: to answer your questions I used to come back in 2014 and I liked the food back before the road was closed and from what I remember the beer bar was being built. This time I had the burger and the burger was over well done - the sauce on the burger did not complement it well at all. The bacon on the burger was less than desirable as well. My wife’s was the same as mine so it didn’t seem like a one off with my food being bad.

resp.text: Hi Eric. It’s the same menu as before. I’m sorry you didn’t enjoy the burger. We would have happily made you another one.  Could you let me know how the restaurant has “changed for the worse”?  We have completely remodeled and have been enjoying tons of positive feedback. All of our burgers are excellent and made by hand.

They also offer vegetarian and vegan options so tell all your plant based friends in Ocean Springs, MS!!

name: Jeff Herrera
text: Mosaic is the place to be in downtown Ocean Springs. The patio atmosphere is great, and I have no idea what they do, but even being outside in the summer guests seem very comfortable. I feel like the live entertainment and artists that the restaurant has on evenings are very enjoyable. The staff is friendly and helpful, not to mention relatable when you are asking their opinions for menu choices. Having access to the Beer House from the patio just adds to the restaurant's unique and fun environment. Finally, and most importantly, the food - as unique as the environment and enjoyable as the ambiance, there is no doubt that Mosaic has some of the freshest and most delicious food options on the MS Gulf Coast.

text: The food was very delicious. The atmosphere was lively and fun. The service was excellent! It was my first time eating there and I highly recommend it! They have live music and dueling pianos on the weekend.

We eat out on the patio and had live music .. very groovey and down to earth atmosphere. If you are passing through  ocean springs you got to try this place... The whole area has a hip vibe like you've been transported back to 1970

name: Kenzi Aurora
text: Came here on a Saturday night and service was awful we waited for over an hour for drinks. Received the wrong appetizer and decided to give up an order nothing else. we had to ask for a different waitress because our waitress was so and inattentive and busy flirting with a group of boys that we had to get somebody else who clearly had too many tables. Food and drinks might have been great not sure.

resp.text:
Hi McKenzi,

I am a little confused by your review.  Did you speak to the on-duty manager?  Did you mention the length of the ticket time to the host?  Was any of this brought to our attention?  We are always trying to do our best to provide a customer the best experience they can.  The young woman was not "flirting" with a group of boys.  Rather, she was taking their order.  You were not here an hour.  We checked the cameras and you were sitting outside during a performance of band with a packed courtyard for eleven minutes.  Total.  This is a fact and I would happily share the video with you.  I would also like to mention that you gave a one star review to Chik-fil-A and to Waffle House. Next time please feel free to speak to someone if your order is taking longer than expected and we will happily help.  We have great food and drinks by the way.

And several mins later comes back to tell my son and husband they're making tea, and sets the appetizer down. This is 11 min in..So we order. Food came out the same as the drinks, at different times. My Son was given someone else's order and his was late coming out in the 1st place so now our food is cold and we're waiting yet again for the right order to come. The waiter apologized in passing and acted as if it were beyond his control. We never got a refill and was only asked if everything was ok twice. He seemed relieved we didn't need anything. My steak was mostly fat and they had only worstshere sauce, no A-1 or 57. What??! At this point I don't want to eat. No one said anything because it was Mother's Day and such a beautiful Day left to enjoy. Will I eat there again? Yes. The food was good once we got it. I just won't have their ribeye. And I wont have him for a waiter. Clearly he needs waiter training and people skills. It's all about timing, delivery and personality. He lacked in all areas.

name: Niki Kline
text: This place is despicable. They had two different shoes (Sperry's) in a box & tried to not make an exchange for me. They were slightly different cookies, & had different serial numbers. They said they were worn. Why would we wear 2 different shoes out? The manager brought out a pair of shoes that were supposed to be "clean" & show the only way they'd take a return. There was a wad of gum on the "unworn shoes." She tried quickly to shove them back in the box. I told her, "Oh no. I need a picture of how they should look." They refused to fix their mistake. So, I left & had my husband take them back the next week. He had no issues. I watched them shame an older lady in her late 60's who brought her box in with 2 different Clark's shoes in it. They told her the issue was with Clark's & she'd have to take it up with them. They would not exchange her shoes. The girl said, "Mam, how could it possibly be our fault? The box comes from Clark's. They ship them to us. You have to contact them." How, you ask? The box isn't sealed you ignorant girl. A customer, or more likely someone who works there, gets a kick out of swapping shoes into other boxes. I have talked with other customers & I have found out about 3 other incidents with different shoes, & many others where they just refused to exchange a purchase. Do NOT SHOP HERE!

resp.text: We have forwarded this review to the General Manager of that location and the Director of Stores. If the customer mentioned to the cashier that the reason that they were returning the shoes was because of the mismatch we certainly should have exchanged the shoes. As far as the customer discussing other issues that she has overheard, we are not aware of those issues and would ask those customers to contact us directly since they have not at this point.

name: Scott McKenzie
text: I haul furniture loads for several different stores regularly. Many times at Kirkland's stores, they don't have enough people on hand to unload their delivery in a timely manner. I absolutely have to give Katie (and the crew she had on the clock) props for one of the best Kirkland's deliveries I've ever made. They oughtta give that girl a better job and a bigger paycheck!

name: DW H
text: Lots of great stuff here and good prices. Best of all you walk in, they hand you a sales brochure and then leave you alone to browse. No unwelcome following you around, no harassing sales tactics. Overall love coming here.

name: Marie Barnes
text: Kirkland's is my favorite place to go to update my home with the latest style and fresh ideas. I have furnished my home for over 15 years when they was located  in the Edgewater village area. If you are looking for style for every season this is your place!!!

text: They have really cute home decor and super friendly staff. Honestly it's all a bit overpriced but I guess there isn't much they can do about that.

text: Walked in and was asked about 5 times if I needed help which is sweet until I was asked 3 times if I was ready to check out lol Maybe they thought I was stealing, I'll admit I'm a slow shopper but it's because im super picky on value. After the 3rd time of being asked if I was ready I turned to her and said, tell you what when im ready I'll be at the cash register, promise. She almost rolled her eyes guess she didnt like that. Oh well. Aside from that they have adorable decor and I got a couple lovely frames.
