name: Paul Black
text: We came looking for stuffed flounder, and we're not disappointed. I had the flounder on a previous visit, and it was phenomenal! This time I had an excellent steak (with an add-on of grilled shrimp) that was cooked to perfection. My wife was silent throughout her flounder, as she was thoroughly impressed not only with the fish, but the crab stuffing inside as well. I forgot to mention that the crawfish tails appetizer is something that should not be overlooked. Excellent food, excellent service. This place is our go-to for seafood!

name: patsy thibodeaux
text: Beautiful scenery and great food! Service was good and friendly staff.  Fried crab claw appetizer was very good and hubby’s roast beef poboy was spot on.

name: john b
text: Fantastic as always! No wonder these guys have survived multiple hurricanes, oil spills covid. They've been doing it forever, and doing it the best.

name: Linda
text:
It was nice. Our first time there. I was a little disappointed in the seafood platter. Not too much seafood. Lots of fries. A few more oysters would be nice. Why bother with those claw tails(?)  Wont buy that again.
Waitress was nice and the man who went around making sure we were happy is a great asset to the place. Getting us silverware, raising the blinds so we could see the sunset. Hes a keeper!

name: Amy Bobinger
text: Always excellent food and service.. perfect if you want fresh local seafood. You won't leave hungry!

name: G P
text:
Excellent in every detail.
A family owned & operated nice seafood restaurant with regional style.
We enjoy the atenttion, food, beverages, and service

name: Justin Hamrick
text: I'm pretty sure almost everyone who goes to White Cap will enjoy it.  I had the oyster poboy, and it was delicious!  Next time, I'm getting the Crab-Stuffed Blackened Flounder - my mom ordered it.  It looked so good, I just HAD to try a piece!  I'm glad that I did; it WAS delicious!!!

name: Tracee Lee Beebe
text: Loved this place. Stuffed shrimp is awesome. Shrimp Ship Island pasta is great. Can't wait to go back and try more stuff.

name: Scott Nina
text: Here is the reason I give four stars. We had excellent service and we had timely service and we had good food. We ordered garlic shrimp scampi with pasta and a side salad and we had a cup of bisque and a cup of gumbo. The bisque was some of the best we've ever had. The shrimp scampi with garlic was excellent great flavors. All dishes were served with hush puppies which were excellent by the way. Also complementary saltine crackers were served. Blue Moon beer draft served without an orange slice. We did not like the gumbo it had Seafood in it but the gumbo itself did not have a seafood flavor. Check out the photos that we posted. I highly recommend the bisque.

name: Chandler Braswell
text: Not as good as I remember from a few years ago. Fried pork chop was a little on the dry side and green beans were yucky. Service was ok but could have been more attentive to drink levels.

name: dung nguyen
text: Too blend and too expensive for my taste. Everything was lukewarm and not enough seasoning. Got the gumbo it was bland got the red bean also bland and the fried fish was not cold but barely warm plus we only came here cause of the oysters and guess what they didn't have any eventhough we saw them on the bar chilling on ice so either they were lazy or they were bad. I wouldn't recommend this place but hell ill give them another try later.

name: T L
text: Covid climate dining wasn’t too bad. We ate inside because it was way too hot to eat outdoors. The food was decent. I had grilled shrimp with potatoes and slaw. The slaw had the most flavor. I thought the grilled shrimp and potatoes were bland. My friend had the red fish which was better.

name: Sandra Strain
text: This is a staple for us at the Coast. We have to eat here is always wonderful!

name: Wolfie 444
text: The food was amazing and cooked exactly the way we asked for it. I had a Ahi tuna &shrimp creole. Miss Anita was our waitress. She was very helpful and a lot of fun!  She made a very good impression on us and we will definitely be going back.

name: Cynthia Gillespie
text: Had a party of 6.  We were celebrating a birthday. The servers were nice but the food was not what it used to be.  We paid about the average price for seafood here on the coast but did not get anywhere close to the servings that are served at other locations.  They were nice enough to do shrimp poboys for some of us even though they don't serve those at dinner, only lunch.  The poboy I was given had very small popcorn like shrimp and we counted 9 shrimp total. The other two were the same way.  It was mostly bread.  My child's fish plate had 2 small pieces of catfish but was however filled with fries.  The shrimp platter that was ordered had nice shrimp but it was served with a salad that had some dark spots on the lettuce so she picked through it. The other salad ordered with the shrimp pasta was fine however the pasta was served cold.  To top it all off,  we got home and all had diarrhea.  Very disappointed.

name: Iris coats
text: I do like the White Cap. The food is good and the staff is professional. There was a problem with one of the people in my party and the server remedied it with class and the person was happy. I had the fried oysters with new potatoes and coleslaw. Everyone in my party was very satisfied.

name: Mark Landreneau
text: Great food. Great price

name: Tonya Forester
text: Food quality is not what it used to be.  Cold soggy crab cakes. Flounder was overcooked and  rubbery.  It used to THE PLACE.Not so much now.

name: Cocoa Conerly
text: The seafood platter is good. The food is not over seasoned. We always have the house margarita which is good and strong. The staff is great and they do follow CDC guidelines.

name: Buford Norris
text:
Great food & Service as usual
Very clean ... we felt at ease from covid

name: Butch Simpson
text: Great evening out with my son. Good was excellent! One of the best country fried steaks I've ever had. They were following all the COVID guidelines. Our server, Connie, was top notch.

name: Alex Par
text: Great food and service. The plater used to be bigger with more seafood. Thank you COVID-19.

name: Chip Vaughan
text: Best fried oysters and shrimp in Gulfport!!  Staff is friendly, compliant with COVID-19 restrictions.

name: Tim McGowan
text: Definitely one of the best restaurants on The Coast! Great food and service are the normal here. We all need to support our local restaurants.

name: Oleksandr T
text: Raw oysters are good here, but I didn't enjoy fried seafood

name: Maureen Charbonnet
text: A family favorite for years, but not today;  maybe it was an off day.  Nothing was as good as it usually is.  When the manager asked, I gave him an honest answer.  I wasn't trying to get out of paying for anything.  He dismissed me while I was telling him the service had been good.  Left one of our once favorite places feeling like we had lost an old friend.  We had driven an hour just to have lunch.

name: Michelle Fields-DeDeaux
text: I was looking forward to eating there today. It's usually one of my favorite seafood restaurants on the Gulf Coast. However my shrimp scampi was just not up to par! The two cheeseburgers that my son and my husband had looked phenomenal. My husband said taste it really great!  I really wish that my food was as great as our server. 🤷🏽‍♀️ slightly disappointed 😞

name: paul clifton
text:
The staff is wonderful.
They served a most delicious and savory whole and broiled and stuffed flounders.
Great.
We will come back again

name: Melissa McDaniel
text: It was ok....I would rather pay a little more and have you fill the Poboys up with shrimp. Not a lot on there. Plenty of other places on the coast fill them slammed up for the same price.

name: Buddy Dennis
text: Good food, good service.

name: Janice Franklin
text: Food was good and service was really great.

name: Chadwick jones
text:
2 of us (meeting 4 others) got there a few minutes before they opened, so we went and sat on their outside deck with no one else in sight. The owner comes out and runs us off because they were "not open yet." He has no personality, no people skills. I talked to a waitress out in the parking lot who told me that he treats the wait staff horribly as well.

Had we not been meeting 4 others who planned the meet-up, I would not have eaten there.  Nor will I, or any group I am with, ever eat there again.

Especially if you are from out of town and want an enjoyable cultural experience on the MS gulf coast... do NOT eat at White Cap.

name: Trevor Bingham
text: I've driven by this place and always wanted to try it. The exterior just looks like an old fish house on the wharf. The interior is very nicely decorated. There is a great view of the water through the large windows along the front of the restaurant. The service was good. Our server suggested a few different menu items. I ordered the Shrimp Ship Island. It was very good.

name: Keith L. Bush
text: The waitress was superb. She made the White Cap expedience great!!!! Oh yeah the food was good toobut the wait staff has extremely excellent customer service.

name: Ashley Whitfield
text: This food is not authentic seafood. Tastes frozen and the cocktail shrimp are little baby salad shrimp. Definitely would not recommend.

name: Jon Ochampaugh
text: Food is very good but it's a little pricey, it's not a place I would eat at regularly

name: latonya segrest
text: This is a amazing Restaurant n they have the best Oyster's

name: Menchu King
text: Good service and food.

name: Misti Little
text: By far my favorite seafood restaurant! The grilled oysters are amazing and that stuffed crab is to die for. The service is always wonderful and the atmosphere is comfortable and quiet!!

name: Tiffany Gurganus
text: Pasta was great and the service was great but the crab cakes were horrible

name: Pam Pourciau
text: Great fried crab claws appetizer and the Mahi Mahi was grilled perfectly.

name: Billy Fore
text: Food is ok and good service. The view is worth it.

name: Joe White
text: Food very good but somewhat slow service for the amount of business they had. Don't be in a hurry.

name: Helen T
text: Good Red Fish...shrimp over cooked.  Great views.

name: Vernon Brown
text: Very good place everything was awesome

name: Robert Sherrill
text:
Edit- went today March 19, absolutely terrible.
Seafood platter tastes like a $23 plate of Long John Silvers. Came for oysters but they were $19 a dozen. Won't be back.

name: Celia Alexander
text: Our server was amazing and super friendly. Great service. And the food was really delicious.

name: Kimberly Manuel
text: Awesome service.  The drinks and food were amazing!!  Beautiful ocean view

name: Siege Prestige
text:
My review also comes from personal workforce experience here while I was employed here.

What they do that you don’t see: They don’t wear hairnets and most of them wear no gloves. They touch all the food with their bare hands. The person who is cleaning dishes puts up dirty dishes so now you’re eating food on unclean dishes. The workers also will stick their bare hands in already cooked food and eat it. They also complain and talk about the customers whom they are serving. You left them a $20 tip? They don’t think it’s enough. The whole establishment is unprofessional and truly does not care for its customers.

name: Joseph Williams
text: Me and my dad checked this place out in 2000 by the harbor , absolutely my favorite place to eat , Now Even 20 years later me and my family visit when we visit the gulf Coast every year .

name: Stacy Jacques
text: The food is amazing. The prices are very reasonable. The staff was very warm and welcoming!

name: brian greenwald
text: Excellent food!!!...large portions...Great Service by Laura...we will return.....

name: John Banik
text: Was not impressed at all by the service or the food. The crab cakes were probably the worst we have ever had. The potatoes were bland and had no seasoning on them.

name: Magen Reed
text: Delicious food with friendly staff. Wonderful place to eat and relax after a day on the water!

name: Alec Sanner
text: Everything was good but I had to take a star for one important rule with me. Never break your noodles. Please don't take this as hate, but more as constructive criticism! Believe me the food and the service was great. I just say change that and it's back to a 5 star!

name: Sam Hinkley
text: It's okay. To be honest, I was a bit disappointed. You don't get what you pay for. Very little flavor and my Tuna was extremely overcooked, even though I asked for medium rare. We took home leftovers and seasoned it ourselves and it was much more tolerable. I would eat there if it were like $7.00 a meal, but it's not. Upside? The location AND the decor are awesome.

name: Dustin Hardin
text: My first time here.  The food was good.  A little crowded though considering social distancing but all good.

name: shannon roberts
text: Food and service is top notch!  Love the atmosphere♡ They also have one of the coolest fish tanks I've ever seen!

name: uhura reid
text: Love seafood come here all the time

name: Megan Richard
text: Food was delicious!!! Definitely going back!!!  Loved sitting outside in fresh air looking at the beach!!!

name: Paula Knight
text: Very clean restaurant inside and out, Food was fantastic and worth the cost, Waitress was very friendly and  Attentive Will definitely go back sometime

name: LaDonna
text:
Hannah was our server and she was very good!  We were a table of 10, but she kept up!  I ordered the catfish and shrimp plate.   There was plenty of fish (7 strips) and half a dozen decent sized shrimp. It came with two sides and a hush puppy.  I chose fries and cole slaw for my sides.  The slaw was ok.  I've had better. The fries were neither golden nor crispy, but very pale.   It seemed they were cooked just enough to heat them through. Anyway, the fish and shrimp we really good.  They were seasoned just right and came out hot and fresh.

My beloved had a bowl of corn and crawfish bisque ($3 upcharge) and the stuffed shrimp for her entree.  That bisque was full of deliciousness! It was rich and full of flavor.  But don't add any salt to it, because it was already on the verge of being salty. The stuffed shrimp were only 4 in number, but were HUGE.  The crabmeat stuffing was delicious.

My overall impression of White Cap is that it is clean and friendly, and has a nice seafood theme in the restaurant. I really liked the fish tank at the front of the restaurant.  (Our group stood and admired it for about 10 minutes!)  Anyway, the menu is a bit overpriced (my plate was about $18 by itself), but I suppose that is to be expected for a restaurant on the beach. I liked it, but because I can find good seafood for less, this might be a one time dining experience.  I would, however, recommend this place to friends of they don't mind paying the price!

name: Gary Hamilton
text: redfish was good...never order the shrimp cocktail, it was made with tiny salad shrimp, really 1/2 inch long shrimp not an exaggeration. Why?

name: Marie Hunt
text: Great atmosphere and service! Food was good, but would have been better if it wasn't so bland.

name: Ron Marshall
text: Good food and good service

name: Kat Schollian
text: Did not care for the crawfish bisque. Only 2 small crawfish very chewy. Waitress was great. She took it off my bill. Average seafood. Stuffed crab had to much mayonnaise. Could not eat.

name: Sandra Hanchett
text: Great food and service!

name: Mark Powell
text: Service awful, portions small for price, it's been a while and it will be even longer before I spend my money  there.

name: Butch Snyder
text: Great, love it

name: Christos Caplanis
text: My favorite place to eat Oysters off the beach

name: Dane Reid II
text: Enjoyed eating on the covered front porch looking over beautiful MS Sound. Food and service was great too.

name: Michael Dauzat
text: Food was good,waitress was a little "high" energy/ slightly arrogant ..Food was ok..The stuff crab taste like it was dipped in gulf water an cooked..

name: Rockin Robyn
text: Was going to give it a 5 but loved the shrimp dinner on the weekend,took a to go order couple days later and there was half the amount of shrimp.

name: mutinta jones
text: Love this food and their service is great.

name: George Cookus
text: Delicious food and the Bloody Mary's were among the best we've ever had. Very cool decor ( totally wanted to steal the huge taxidermied crabs)  get there early cuz there is a line out the door. After a few cocktails and so much food I felt like I might split open the bill was still very reasonable. Also had a girl making balloon animals for the kids.  Which waz cool.

name: Regi Hinton
text: Some of the best seafood on the Gulf coast.  Friendly staff and good view of the Biloxi beach.

name: Kenneth Jones
text: Nice relaxed atmosphere overlooking the beach. Dine inside or out. Very efficient and friendly staff. Shrimp poboy was great. Moderate prices but not overly priced. Great spot on the beach. Highly recommended.

name: Liberty Sharp
text: The grilled Perch, parsley potatoes & Cole slaw was delicious! Hubby had Shrimp Scampi- he was so impressed with the taste, as well as amount of food ! Our server was Tracy, she made sure our needs were met- always had a smile . We plan to return soon & will ask for Tracy!

name: Fannie Williams
text: Location is off the beach. Friendly staff and atmosphere. My first visit.  Bread pudding was delicious.   It was a group of us celebrating two of our friends Birthdays.

name: Debra Deese
text: I've been here many times over the years and the food has been consistently good. They have a good atmosphere here. The employees have always been friendly and attentive even though they are usually very busy. This is a good restaurant to visit if you are looking for a good seafood meal. I do recommend a visit if you are in the area.

name: Kimberly Darrah
text: Excellent service

name: Barbara McNeal
text: Far and away the best restaurant I have been to on the coast!  The food was great and the atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable.  The service was excellent.  I strongly recommend giving this place a try when you are in the area!

name: Lekeysha Miller
text: Great food and service.

name: Rachel Francis
text: One of the reasons we go to the coast. We ALWAYS eat at the White Cap.Been doining it for years!!!!

name: Dede Wrzosk
text: Love the food. Great place. To eat. . l went with my friends .  we love it. We be come back soon.

name: Presley McNiel

name: Tyler Simser
text:
Family atmosphere for sure.  Has seating in side and out.
We started with the fried dill chips.  They are thicker cut than other restaurants so if you really like dill pickles then you will love it.  It was fried in corn meal batter which I wasn't not a big fan of.
I had stuffed shrimp and hushpuppies.  Really liked the hushpuppies, not dry but the stuffed shrimp was dry.  Had a good flavor though.
My family had raw oysters and they said it tasted good and the size was perfect.
Our waitress was very attentive and was good at clearing the table while keeping our drinks full.

Ask to be seated in Brenda's section and I guarantee a five star over all dining experience.

I probably wouldn't go if I was looking for a healthy option, there's only a couple of things on the menu that could be considered a healthy choice. The view is great, the restaurant is north of the beach and you can look out the windows and  see the gulf. The previous white cap that was destroyed by Katrina had more salt water aquariums in it, the current restaurant only has one, though it is a very nice one.

text:
Great Go To place

White Cap is medium price restaurant with great service and great food. I like everything,  but I'm particularly fond of the onion rings and their gumbo. Enjoy the wonderful views of the Gulf while dining. I prefer indoors, but if you don't mind the noise,  outside is good as well, especially during Cruisin' the Coast.  All the cars come by.

name: Dave Thompson
text: The food was good, but it was the usual fare, fried fish, fried this and that,at burger's, seafood, that kind of thing. The food was not bad at all, I enjoyed it, there were  just no surprises. There was nothing to make this place specifically stand out. The waitress was wonderful, the hostess was wonderful, the service was just fine. They had an atmosphere that was happy, it was very busy on a Wednesday night and it does seem that the locals really enjoy this place. It was clean, prettily decorated, and as I said, had a happy atmosphere.

After getting our drinks she then had another server bring them to us and waited another 5-10 minutes before she came back to get our orders. We had 6 adults and our orders were easy 2 cheese burgers with potatoes instead of fries and salad, 2 shrimp plates 1 with coleslaw and potatoes and a fish platter and a half dozen oysters.The server mixed up our orders and charged us for the extras she had to go back and get. We were sitting right in front of the oyster bar and the server had to pass us several times going back and forth outside. She was very inattentive the entire time and our food came out luke warm from another server! The food was not very good and neither was the service. We did not complain to the manager as they were busy when we checked out and we knew we would not return.

Ok, I'm alright with that, maybe, but the po boy comes with fries which I usually dont eat, so sub onion rings or something with an up charge Nope cant be done, I'm told the kitchen won't do it.  We also had the crab and corn bisque, it was barely room temperature. So we ask if it can be heated and it comes back the same.  We decide that's as good as it's going to get so we eat it.  The food was average but not exceptional for the price and the lack of flexibility in the menu  for simple requests will keep me from coming back. I do not recommend White Cap.

name: Shomari G
text:
I had a very unpleasant experience upon visiting this location; both myself and my partner were blatantly and unreasonably monitored as we made our way through the store.

We were casually browsing products in the store, with a particularly focus on seasonal offerings we had seen online, when not one, not two - but three employees - descended on us within one to two minutes of each other, near the fitting rooms in the rear, in what was an indiscreet attempt at ushering us towards the front of the store; the dialog from the staff along with the blatantly executed aggressive customer service made it all too disappointingly clear what was occurring to us.

To add insult to injury, as we made our way to the front of the store, towards the exit, we stopped to browse the holiday offerings, and some accessories. One of the staff members (appeared to be management) followed us and sat down on a bench within eyesight and kept an eye on us until we left.

I'll be contacting the corporate office with further details and feedback concerning my decidedly negative experience at this store.

name: Kathe Newcomb
text: Stein Mart is the BEST!! I usually shop the sales, which have great values. They have unique, stylish clothing, and I always get compliments on the pieces I've bought there. This store is well-kept, clean, and amazingly organized, considering how much inventory has to be moved around the store daily! The personnel are friendly and helpful, without being intrusive. It's my favorite place to shop!

name: Jamena Stewart
text: First of all, I would recommend reservations. We arrived around 5:30 to a nearly empty restaurant, but had to wait an hour before a table was available. Michael, our server, was great! House salads came out beautifully wrapped in cucumber crowns. I highly recommend the balsamic vinaigrette! My friend ordered a red fish special topped with lobster. The fish was flavorful but the lobster was overcooked and rubbery.  I opted for the short rib ravioli which was beyond amazing. Served in a decadent sauce, the pillows of pasta were presented in  a thickened, rich demi-like gravy. The dish is typically prepared with bleu cheese but I asked for another option and got Parm instead. The fresh wheat rolls and garlic knots will melt in your mouth, but don't fill up on them. Try to save room for dessert!

name: Sara Carlson
text: Me and my husband went here for Valentine's Day! the food was wonderful and service was okay.🤔 This was our first time at this restaurant, so we were not familiar with the menu at all and our waiter didn't seem to offer any drink or menu item suggestions. A matter of fact, he didn't seem to even greet us or make it a point to speak to us at all, other then asking "Are you ready to order?". Also it took quite some time for him to even come over to our table or even acknowledge us. He took our drink order, I got a carona because I didn't feel like getting a headache later from drinking wine or champagne. My husband stuck to water because he was driving that night. It seems that our waiters judgmental, assuming attitude started right from the beginning at the point of ordering drinks. Not to mention it already seemed like he was dancing around coming over to our table in the first place. We decided to go with the $80 per couple Valentine's day special because he seemed as if he didn't want to take our order or spend any more time at our table than he had to. Everything tasted delicious and food was placed on the table in a timely order and fashion. However, I feel that because we did chose the special, our waiter treated us as if we didn't belong or we couldn't afford to be there or we weren't going to be able to tip him properly. This was uncomfortable and uninviting and kinda assuming on his behalf. His snide attitude and the lack of friendliness towards us kinda put a damper on our night that originally started off with all smiles. About half way through our appetizer we noticed what appeared to be a Manager walking around greeting and speaking to everyone. Then when he got to our table I smiled at him but he didn't smile back at us or speak to us but instead skipped over us and went to the next table to greet and speak to them. At that point I asked my husband if I had something in my teeth or on my face he said "No and Why?" I replied "because he looked at me as if I did." So when I seen him speaking and greeting our friends across the room I thought well  maybe hes only speaking to people he knows but that turned out not to be the case because when we asked our friends if they knew him, they stated "No, he was just checking on us to make sure we were enjoying our night and had everything we needed." So at that point I could only assume he was being judgmental about my carona sitting on the table versus a fancy glass or bottle of champagne. I say that because I seen him look at the beer on the table right before he skipped over us and went to the table next to us. Thank goodness the host and busser was friendly and willing to answer any questions. I only wish our waiter would have been just as friendly as the Host and Busser that night. At the end of our meal we decided to take our desserts to-go because we were stuffed. Our waiter placed them on the table and said he would be back with a bag for us to put them in. He took the book with the bill to cash us out and when he came back he never brought our bag for our to-go items. Instead he put the checkbook back on the table and walked off, not even saying goodbye or anything  After that we didn't see him again, so the busser ended up getting us our to-go bag. I'm sure that our waiter felt kinda dumb after we left him a good tip, despite the way he treated us, as if we didn't matter or belong...! Hopefully he won't be so judgmental about younger couples who visit for the first time! All in all we enjoyed our night out away from kids and our delicious meal. Even though our waiter was a not welcoming and the Manager smiled and greeted almost everyone except us and we lost hundreds in the casino that night. If we decided to give it another try later in the future, we'll definitely be making sure that we request a different waiter or waitress.!  Other than that, it's a beautiful restaurant and wonderful food, that was cooked to perfection...!

text: Its mighty, its historic, its beautiful and it's our favorite river. Mark Twain loved it and so do we. It starts in a lake in Minnesota called Lake Itasca and travels down through many states ending its journey in the Gulf of Mexico at Louisiana near New Orleans. name: Luann Ley Davis
text: Came here for my daughter's Birthday weekend. Had 3 rooms in the "platinum" tower and the view was gorgeous. However,  the room was not as clean as I'd hoped it would not- not sure last time bathroom floors were mopped- former guests hair in shower drain and remnants of a bad toilet experience left was a nasty welcoming gift. Bed sloppily made and hard as a rock (perhaps to remind us of what hotel we were at?). We understood that due to covid, there was zero housekeeping for our 4day/3night stay; however,  was only given 1 roll of toilet paper and called multiple times for another that finally showed up as we were checking out- had to use the cheap facial tissue. No fridge or microwave and you only get 1-day of coffee pods and 2 mini-bottled waters, so bring your own water or pay $3 for 10oz waters at the Duncan Donuts downstairs.  The casino was very nice- good assortment of slots and table games. Staff kept the machines and gambling areas very clean. Ruth's Chris steakhouse and oyster House both good food but LONG so plan on 3 hour stays for dinner. Pool was closed first day & a half of our stay- was beautiful,  but pool was about 30° and unbearable to swim in, so both hot tubs were packed. Would come here to gamble again, but would not stay in the hotel. Gambling =fun, hotel = awful.

text:
Hello everyone I had an excellent visit and this place left an impression on me! A goid one!

I had a SUPERIOR time at the Hard Rock Cafe! It was the most fun I have had in years! It was the first time I have ever gone to a casino and I was smiling from the time I got to the casino, until a little after I got home! My server at the Hard Rock Cafe was prompt and friendly and cute!
It was easy to park at the Hard Rock Cafe, so we chose them instead of the other casino we visited before Hard Rock. I took a ton of pictures while I was here and enjoyed every moment of my experience here! The visual concepts and layout of the establishment were very fluid and easy to navigate, all the way down to the layout and design of the restrooms. Very Clean. Very organic transition from the wash station to the stalls and back on to the casino floor.

My fiance and I finally got an afternoon where we were able to get out and enjoy the coast as we live very close it and boy was it fun! I havent been in such a good mood in a long time! The staff were knowledgable and gave us insight into how everything workes when we entered the casino floor where they ID at. Very friendly man there. He knows his stuff. The Floor manager at the casino let us know a few things about how to pay in and cash out and where to do so. Very informative. And I will come by hear again some time and just enjoy the scene if not anything! It is that easy on the eyes! Anyways, great place to spend the day. We havent rented any rooms but Im sure we will want to do so in the future. Thank you Hard Rock Cafe for the excellent experience!

The menu books were left on  our table the entire time.  Looking around we didn't see that going on with anyone else, maybe because we came from the pool and didn't dress up to come in there not sure but it wasn't a good first impression.  The milkshakes arrived when I asked for the checks, then I asked if the glasses could go to the hotel room because they were done with their food and it stunk they didn't get them with their food like the family who sat after us and taken care of by the same waiter better than us.   The food was great they loved it.  The milkshakes were good to taste but felt like they had been left sitting they were runny liquid more like chocolate mile not a milkshake.  MAJOR DISAPPOINTMENT won't visit their again or recommend the sugar factory to eat.   The buffet was amazing everything wonderful and wonderful service.   First time reaching a higher tier player status and not sure where the benefits come in at Hard Rock, no one seems to have time to explain when you ask and when you call in it's you have to come in person.   Love the view or the pool.  Room was nice.  Two rude events Sugar Factory and the pool  shop girl.   Sorry Hard Rock you disappointed because customer service matters.   Tons of slots, takes over an hour for waitress to bring back drink and tipping doesn't matter still takes over an hour after being asked.

text: Everything you need is in the hotel and casino. There's a Hard Rock Cafe, 24/7 Grille, Ruth Chris, Half Shell, Dunking Donuts, Ben & Jerry, Pie Five. The hotel room I was on the Royal Tower. Our shower door was broken and maintenance came and got it to where it was usable but it needed to be replaced and he would have to find a door. It didn't have a fridge or microwave which I'm sure is to limit you to purchasing from their own stores and not outside stores. Smart business plan on their part but it can be inconvenient if you did buy a meal from one of their places and had leftovers you wanted to fridge or heat up later. The pool area looked nice but was crowded so we went to the beach instead. The casino machines were a bit tight though. The Beau Rivage is next door and is in walking distance. There is a path that takes you right to it. Overall I enjoyed my stay and would come again to try the platinum tower rooms.

name: heather thomas
text: We had a horrible experience last night at The Sugar Factory inside the Hard Rock. We arrived 30 min before our reservation (8:30 p.m.) and we still did not leave until midnight. It took iver 2 hrs to receive our food. One dish was brought 1 hour before the rest of the food. We were told we would be given a discount on our bill for the inconvenience and when they came back with the bill it was 4 dollars higher than before we received the "discount". No special sauce on the burgers because they apparently ran out but no one who worked there knew for sure. We were not told ahead of the burgers coming out that they wouldn't have sauce or asked if we still wanted then since they would be burgers without a condiment or if we wanted to change our order. Management was no where to be found towards the end of our visit. The candy store next to the restaurant was shut down by the time our meal ended so we were first denied access eve though it wasn't our fault because we would have come before they closed if our food didn't take so long. There was one last Debbie who allowed us to come in to take pictures since thats all we wanted to do not buy candy. Overall a very bad experience we tried to remain positive and give them a chance but the night got progressively worse. Theyve been open for 4 months so wait at least a year before you attempt to go and hopefully they'll have it together.

Thank you for taking your time to provide this review. I am disappointed with the level of service you received during your visit. text:
My son has played at The Hard Rock Cafe at least 3x and we love it there. Love the new hotel, love the atmosphere with all the great  music playing constantly, love the employees, especially seeing a lot of our past friends from when we were in the business years ago. The bartenders at the MAIN BAR ARE THE BEST! John and Kristen or Krista (Missy's Little Sister *Big Smile* in case I got her name wrong...) Always smiling, make great drinks and will hold a conversation with you if you are alone! The live music at Main Bar is usually pretty great too. I love the Rock Shop and the boutique (forgot name!) The staff at both places have been THE most friendly staff I've ever encountered at a casino shoppe on the Mississippi Gulf Coast! (and I'm not even a "High Roller", they treat everyone the same!). All of the rooms in the hotels are incredible whether you stay in a suite or a regular room. Staff is awesome in Hotels as well.
The Hard Rock Hotel Resort and Casino in Biloxi is my all time favorite place to go. It must be the music! ✌

Decorated with memorabilia, colorful, and lively.  For those who enjoy modern and classic rock, the Hard Rock is the place to go.

Variety of stores up front, including Ben & Jerry's, a pizza shop, and a clothing shop.

Buffet lacked the kind of variety I see at the Palace Casino, but the food was good--I much prefer dining at the Hard Rock Cafe when I can.  Actual casino seemed smaller than the one at the Palace, but I'm no big gambler and didn't really wander around.  Cocktail waiters attentive and quick.

name: Tonya Whitten
text:
24/7 Grill is where we were. I have never had a negative thing to say about 24/7 bc it has always been a upbeat, inviting open, fun place to go sit down relax and just chill while eating some awesome food. Never has it been anything but AMAZING, UNTIL NOW. They moved the grille to the back of the casino into this dull, drab, depressing space that feels so closed in and claustrophobic.The cooks are nowhere to be seen-stuck behind a wall in an actual kitchen instead of a "GRILLE" bar setting. We use to sit at the bar and socialize with the cooks and cut up and laugh with them. Now, that's not possible. Our servers have to walk a country mile to the back through another restaurant just to get to the kitchen where our food is and then it comes out with a covered lid like they are trying to be an upscale restaurant. Well it didn't feel that way to me, it felt like I'd just ordered room service. It was horrible. The server who took our order was aggravated that we were complaining about the "new" space and so he took our order and brought our food but never came back. The busser had to take my husband's over-battered, over fried oyster flecks-(can't really call them oysters bc there was hardly an oyster in all that batter), back to the kitchen, he had to refill our drinks and take care of us the whole time bc our server bailed on us-literally left and didn't tell anyone. I got the burger like I usually do and it's usually so amazing. We always tell tourists to go to 24/7 Grille
I am so disappointed in all that's changed here.
I  would not recommend visiting here unless, you’re anti-social and like to hide in a corner to go out to dinner. Then this is your place. Otherwise, I’d just stay home and wouldn’t suggest eating here, that is unless things change. It’s horrible now! 😓😥
FYI HARD ROCK OWNERS- this review was made several, several months ago. Every time we edit our comment or review the date changes on the actual review. So if you’ll notice it updated to just a few minutes ago today, too 3:29pm on Sunday, October 20, 2019.
So, yes, I do know this restaurant has been closed a few months now.
This review was the last time we ever visited.
But thanks for your response, about 6months later. 😉

text:
Edited previous positive review:
Unfortunately, due to recent changes in ownership I'm told, the formerly exceptional customer care here is no more. As a regular visitor, I've witnessed drastic changes over the last 2 months, resulting in a group of 10 of us choosing not to rerurn, sadly. Numerous pieces of machinery throughout the property broken down for a week or more, employees who used to go above and beyond to make sure your stay is special now uninterested as a matter of policy; I've witnessed 3 instances of the casino locking out players accounts and when they go to the players club to find out why, they are publicly shamed and reprimanded for how they use the free play they earned. Scolding that if they don't spend at least $100 of their own money in the same time frame they use free play, their players club benefits will be taken away forever. Most recently, a number of players invited to a gift event they have been attending weekly for some time, told they now had to earn a large number of points (equivalent to $500) in the hours before the giveaway or they would no longer receive the $25 gift they carried invitations for; over $1000 lost in the previous day is no longer realvent to anything. text: Very nice staff, clean casino. They offered a free breakfast, which was nice. Their kiosks need to be a little fine-tuning they move a little too quick however once you're able to slow them down and catch up you do see that you have excellent comps, that have been given to you from some of the local eateries in the casino like Starbucks, Ben & Jerry's, bars and resteaunts that's in there.   Its a nice place to stay. The only complaint I have is that my husband left his charger in a wall socket Behind the Chair it wasn't visible to the naked eye however a few minutes after we were on the the highway we called and they said the room had not been cleaned up and the manager of housekeeping would let the staff know and we could pick it up at security well, we went back a couple of days later to pick it up and they said it was never turned in and no one ever saw it. text:
Bad

Not horrible, but falls under the "it'll make a t**d" category. Most recently, we went on a Saturday night, just after opening, and on a show night. So the expectation was food shouldn't be rushed, as they weren't busy yet, and decent cooks working as there's a show. Yeah...  Right....  The salad was alright. Spinach seemed a little off, and no eggs. Wife complained that the Royal Reds were inedible, and the mac and cheese tasted like it was made with nacho cheese sauce.  My 9 year old liked the greens over the green beans, and wouldn't eat the mac and cheese.  Just let that last sentence sink in.  Lima beans were undercooked, sausage in red beans was near burned and red beans were somewhat crunchy undercooked. Pizzas burned, again the 9 year old passed on it. Fried shrimp and catfish both well overcooked. Cold boiled shrimp were tough, though edible. Cheesecake?  Well the one I had from walmart deli last week was much better, and no I am not exaggerating. Peach cobbler was undercooked on top, chewy peaches, and a burned bottom. The brownies are a definant choking hazard, so be sure to have a full glass of tea to help make it chewable.   This is the third or fourth time we have been very  disappointed in the Hard Rock's buffet, dating back to last December. We have tried the brunch and dinner, and agree we won't be coming back. The Scarlett Pearl has a MUCH better buffet, be it weekend brunch, friday lunch, or a dinner, and costs the same or less.

11 month ago..  This WAS the only casino buffet we go back to. We have tried most all of them, and each is different and has their ups and downs, but the Hard Rock WAS consistently good.

name: Thomas Graham
text:
Have to walk through smoking gambling floor to get to lobby, not exactly what I prefer, I know it’s a casino, but why not have lobby to check in closer to front door. Rooms were ok, bed was comfortable. Never could get hot water for a shower, called twice for 2 extra towels and never got them and ALL night long I could hear doors slamming shut. Staff was nice, but not truly helpful.
Not really sure I would go back.

resp.text:
Hi Thomas,
Thank you for taking the time to write us a review. We apologize that the level of service we strive to maintain was not met during your visit. Your comments are valuable and have been forwarded to the appropriate department. We hope to see you again.

name: B Wedge
text: Good experience. Casino allows smoking so be ready for that. Little profit on the slots 20 got me 60 so I cashed out and headed back to hotel. Highly recommend booking a Tiki tours boat ride for dinner. Cruise the coast line and see some sites hit the nugget on your way back to get your gamble fix on!!!

resp.text:
Hi valued guest,
Thank you so much for your golden five-star review. We are glad that you enjoyed your overall experience and look forward to your next visit!

name: Rob Davis
text: I really enjoyed the breakfast it was just what I wanted & awesome! After we ate we played the slots a lil bit but the only thing I didn't like was that they didn't have any machines where you redeem your cash from your ticket. They really should invest in those machines mainly cause they are very convenient to the costumers.

resp.text:
Hi Rob,
Thank you for taking the time to write us a review. We're glad to hear you enjoyed your most recent visit in the hotel & casino. We value your comments and look forward to your next visit!

name: Chase Kennedy
text:
Rooms look nice and has good views of gulf but the lamp in our room didn't work. Bathroom vanity had piece of wood under one leg to balance the sink. No room service. Lack of info about hotel and casino. No perks for joining players club. Waitresses and bartenders very friendly.
Little too pricey for what u get. But still had a good time.

resp.text:
Hi Chase,
Thank you so much for taking the time to write us a review. We apologize that the level of service we strive to maintain was not met during your visit. Your comments are valuable and have been forwarded to the appropriate department.  We hope to exceed your expectations during your next visit.

text:

Room 1152 has a great view!!

The saying - "first impression is the last impression" is not always as accurate. I called to see if early check-in was available, and I was placed on hold for almost 10 minutes. I hung up, called back, and explained I was on hold for that amount of time. We had that awkward silence because I was waiting to see if she had anything to say - still silence and no apologies. I proceeded to ask if I could check in early, and I was told not at this time. I asked what type of view did the room have, and she flatly stated "view is of the city ma'am." Aside of the initial lack of personable service when I called the first time, my check in time was pleasant, and I really enjoyed my stay. The first impression was erased away, and I was left with a lasting impression of definitely returning again!

I had a mixture of the city and water. Although I didn't capture pictures of the city at night, the lights were beautiful. Harrah's has a lovely light display as well as Margaritaville. Parking was perfect; I was able to look out my window to see my vehicle.

text: The staff has been very helpful and friendly. The hotel room was clean-ish. There was more that could have been done like hairs on the side of the tub. The bathroom just didn't look like it was scrubbed at all. The sink doesn't drain. If you want a fridge in your room, ask and they'll bring one up. They'll charge $10/night unless you tell them you have a medical condition like diabetes like my husband does. Also, our room had the adjoining door in it. We had several different people staying the in room next to us throughout the week. You aren't supposed to smoke in the rooms but most of them did. The smoke smell would come thorough the door into our room. One night one guy was smoking marijuana and it smelled up our entire room. You can also hear their TV very easily. I would suggest to ask for a room without an adjoining door if possible. We did enjoy the view of the Gulf though! Also, the guy that brought up our luggage was a HUGE help. He'll unload it from your car then bring it up to your room. (Don't forget to tip him!) Couldn't have asked for anything more. The sports bar downstairs (Michael Patrick's) was hit-or-miss and pretty expensive when it's a miss. Bubba Gump's and Lillie's was great. Again, all of the staff was extremely friendly and helpful with anything we needed. When you have an extended stay like we did (Sunday- Friday) they don't come in and clean the room or make the bed due to Coronavirus, which is understandable. If you need towels, toilet paper, or anything whatsoever, they are very quick to bring it to you.

name: Sonny Sweatt
text:
Came here, oddly enough, for a business trip. The hotel itself was fine. The room was nice enough, bed was comfortable, etc. it wasn’t fantastic, but it was very good value for the price.

The only issue is that in order to access the hotel you have to go through the casino itself. Literally, you have to walk through the casino floor. Most people probably only go there to gamble, but for those of us that weren’t gambling 1) having to walk through the smoke-and-alcohol-filled space (seriously, super smoky even at 9am!) and 2) getting carded (I’m 33 years old...I guess I looked young to the guy at the entrance from the parking lot) to enter the hotel (random, I was only carded at night...there was no one watching the entrances the other times.) was a bit annoying.

name: Robert Greenhouse
text:
It was changed over from the isle of Capri casino back in 2013, but hasn't really been much of a change because it's pretty much the same staff that don't want to be anything better than what they were since the Golden Nugget took over their players Club even tries to maintain that they don't have to be as good as Atlantic City Golden Nugget because of where they are which the management says dictates that they can't be any different. There is sho much potential, but you have to want to change. I guess the Landry's company does not come here and compare it because on their face they say it's fine. If the players don't know any better they could be content. The AC Golden Nugget only requires 50k points to attain Elite level and Biloxi chooses to be more greedy and wants 100k points for that level with very little in return for your effort. Golden Nugget Atlantic City has a Chairman's lounge for Elite and Chairman level players to eat free! Biloxi Golden Nugget has no valuable benefit for twice the efforts!

Rooms are comfortable with nice sunrise sunset views but there is a block of view on the west side with margaritaville on the one side. Some rooms with the gulf view are excellent on a nice day!
Still not much has changed in 2020! Requiring getting 20 tier points to activate entries you've already earned is just greedy! Do it like many others and just have players place them in a drawing drum! Manually or electronically at the kiosk!

They served me somebody else's meal and it was [lightly] breaded with wheat flour. Awesome😒

If the server had come back to my table even one time after taking my order, I might have found out before eating it all.

I flagged down a manager after, fruitlessly, searching for my server for about 5 minutes and was sorely disappointed by her reaction and that of my server once she was finally made aware of the mistake.

Celiacs be warned!! Do not trust the staff at the Biloxi Bubba Gump's to care about your health or safety. Eat elsewhere.

As far as the rest of my experience at the casino is concerned...I had a blast before the gluten hit! Will, absolutely, return to the casino.

text: Nice casino. One of the best ones on the coast! Almost always clean, friendly dealers and the slots are decent. The club here is nice but small and very limited space but usually pretty great music. The hotel rooms are nice and their price is not bad compared to some. There's a few places to eat and all have good food. Plenty of parking with lots of security. Right on the beach so the warm months makes it very nice plus Margaritaville is literally right next door, it's a casino for kids basically with lots to keep them occupied and staff to keep them safe while you are gambling. Highly recommended

If you eat at any of their restaurants, make sure to sign up with landrys. It's a reward card you earn points and get free food. Add that to food credit and comps!

text:
****EDIT: As of July 11, we will no longer be spending money at the golden nugget. As a family that cooks for a living, a big part of our going out experience is having someone else do the cooking for us. This is our 4th time at the Nugget this summer, and the 3rd time we've been told we cant order room service because the kitchen is closed, and all they have available is cold food, ie., wraps and salads. Two of those times we've been told the kitchen cleaning is 'totally random' and they can't tell us when to avoid coming, in order to miss this kitchen shut down.
Tonight, we were finally told it is every other Wednesday. Why weren't we given this information before? It could've saved a lot of headache. Not to mention, how do you keep your stars if you are not offering room service cooked to order?! This forces us to be inconvenienced and have to walk to Harrahs, a competitor Hotel/Casino, to go to Steak n Shake for a hot meal, and reinforces to us that we are wasting our time and money trying to be loyal to a Casino that does not offer the services we need when we are there. ******

Always a good time at the nugget! Decent slots and food, nice rooms, balcony upon request, what's not to like? I recommend ordering room service over going to the overnight diner if you're up late, you'll get larger servings and more care seems to be taken, and it's not much more expensive at all.

text:
We pulled up to check in for the hotel.  Other cars pulled in behind us so I moved up to make room.  Apparently I infringed on the valet parking turf, nothing marked, but as soon as I got out of the car and attendant comes running over screaming that valet parking is closed.  I replied that was fine as I didn't want valet parking, I just want to check-in at the hotel.  As I continued towards the door, the attendant fetches his boss who then proceeds to get in my face.  I told him the same thing and his only response was for me to drive to the parking garage and hike back.  At this time, the other vehicles I had moved for were unloading by the front door.  I pointed to them and said that's what I wanted to do.  Instead of explaining that I had somehow crossed an invisible line when I pulled up, he kept pointing to the garage.  I ignored him and went inside to check in, all the while with him yelling at me to give him my keys, (I thought valet was closed), and threatening to call security.  I hurriedly checked in and returned to the car.  The jerk attendant was no where to be seen.  We parked in the garage and had to drag our luggage through the entire length of the casino to reach the hotel!
This facility is poorly laid out.  Once inside, you have to navigate through the casino, up an escalator, and down a hall to reach check-in.  From there it's a hike down another hall to the elevators.  The hotel needs a separate entrance and parking.

name: Jeremy Russell
text: I was absolutely disappointed with my stay at the Golden Nugget. There was so much wrong with our room upon arrival. There were no light bulbs at all in the room. We had to have maintenance come up immediately just so we could turn the lights on! The TV did not work properly during our entire stay. They could not fix it. The bathroom was dirty upon arrival and had someone's hair all over the floor. The electrical outlets in the room did not work. We had to have them bring an extension cord to plug into the one spot underneath the bed that had a functional Outlet. None of the normal amenities have been replaced, such as the trash bags, notepads, pens, or even do not disturb signs. We had to call twice at 3 a.m. to get a do not disturb sign and it took 45 minutes before we received it. The gym had 6 broken exercise machines, and no towels available for two days straight despite requesting that they replenish the towels at the gym. The soap in the gym bathroom was gone and was not refilled before we left. But I think What Really Got Me Above All is that I spoke with a manager about all of these problems that we encountered during our first night stay, and they did not do anything but thank me for bringing it to their attention and said that they were glad they were able to fix everything for us. I mean, come on... That's not even an apology. And I don't need handouts from anyone, but I was a little surprised when they didn't offer anything as recompensation for all the time and trouble it took just to get our room straight from the beginning. Over the course of three or four hours we had to have seven people come to our room to fix things that should have been done before we ever arrived. No apology, just a pat on their own back that they could fix everything. I've stayed at Motel 8s that care more about their guests. Absolutely pitiful Golden Nugget. You should be very ashamed.

Now, the only glitch property wide was a power outtage/surge. However, the generators reacted immediately. And, full power was resumed within seconds. I really commend the staff for their professionalism, and calming demeanor, while maintaining  minimal disruption of patron activities.

Last but not least, believe it or not,  I base my return visits on the cleanliness of public restrooms on the casino floor... and this test passed with flying colors!

Overall, I really enjoyed my experience at the Golden Nugget, Biloxi, MS (This property has  name recognition from home, Las Vegas). I am sure the Gulf Coast welcomes this fresh update.

Good luck in your success! It's certainly a win-win-win situation for the owners, the economy, and savvy patrons like myself!

text: We had stayed here when it was Isle of Capri and had been very satisfied with the rates and service but now as the Golden Nugget, our opinion has changed. The weekend room rates were very high so we decided to make it a weekday vacation. Initially the room rates seemed fairly acceptable but, after adding the room tax and something called Room revenue resort fee of 14.54 per night and 14.54 for the third night it was over 120.00 per night and 150.00 for the third night. When I initially reserved the room online the room rate was 95  per night and by my own mistake I thought I had m-w reserved but just reserved mon and tue evenings so, the third night costs me 139 since I didn't reserve it ahead. And it was the same room. No consideration from the hotel or anything. We only had room service 1 of the three days and not because of a do not disturb sign because there wasn't one available in the room. The third day we called to at least get towels and after a second call that finally happened, but they didn't offer to replenish the soaps or anything else, just the bare minimum. There was no "how was your stay" or any pleasentry like that when we checked out just out of professionalism or a courtesy to top it off. In my opinion the place is no longer competitive as there are many other choices along the coast now. We chose Isle of Capri the first time since it was open after the storm and this time since we'd been so satisfied before but lesson learned. We'll return but definitely not the the Golden Nugget.   That's just our experience.

text: My son and I walked across the Biloxi bridge tonight. Once we got to the side that the Golden Nugget is on, we decided to go check out the GN since we had never been inside. Although the inside of the facility did look very nice, there was one thing that was missing....water fountains. We asked an employee where the nearest water fountain was and I was informed that there were none on the property. He then told me that I could buy water at the bar. No thanks! I think that if a casino makes that much money off of it's guests, they should at least provide an occasional water fountain. Although we were not planning on spending much money there tonight, I do go into several other casinos here on the Coast fairly regularly. I will not be taking my money to the Golden Nugget in the future however since they don't think their guests are worth a free sip of water. Advice...check out Hard Rock Biloxi. name: John Poelma
text: Unique shop of found art, metal art, vintage industrial items and more. Owners are great people to talk with.

name: Tim
text: Great place to shop for that special gift and really helpful and friendly staff! We wanted something unique and special to send our daughter and we found it there! And they even packaged it for shipping!!! Great place!!!

name: AP
text: It's such an eclectic shop with tons of unique, hand-made items.  I bought a coaster and a mug, and I love both of them.  I miss coming here now that I have moved away.  It reminds me of good times in Mississippi, and is proud of its heritage.

name: Duane Throckmorton
text: Neat little store. Lots of stuff to see. All unique but I thought prices were a bit high. All in all its a great place to see. Nothing there really struck me as a "I had to have it" item.

name: seth lowe
text: Realky great selection of industrial art pieces. The staff is very friendly and inviting.

resp.text: Thank you Seth,  so glad you enjoyed your visit!!

name: Maureen Blanchard
text:
Cute shop - I wouldn't call it an antique shop - it is decorated with
antiques but it is more like a gift shop.

resp.text: Actually all those antiques aren't just decoration, they are all "for sale"!! We sell "everything" in our store,  furniture, fixtures signs, art & gifts!!

name: K. Ellis
text: Precious store full of local artists and antiques. Great furniture/tables, and accessories.  The owner's wife is amazingly talented!!!  Fun place to look.

name: Holly Hahne
text: I love this store! Lots of fun gifts and nice people to help you.

name: OfNature
text: This place has a very extensive selection of handcrafted art. Worth the stop.

name: Cynthia Russell
text: Best Staff Ever!! Spent so much money there!! Cute clothes & shoes!!!

name: Paul Vining
text: Great antique store, filled with a wide range of items, always something to find in here.

name: Brice Wiggins
text: Great store. Always a unique selection.

name: Michael Hesser
text: Nice place.

name: glenn condra
text: One of the most unique stores I've ever been in Friendly people running it

name: Susan Lewis
text: So many cute and unique things!

name: Kelly Cunningham
text: I love this local store. Their items sold here are made by people from the gulf Coast area. They have home decor, jewelry, kitchen items, art, and other random items. Worth the visit!

name: Josh Crowley
text: One of the cutest little stores you'll find. They have all kinds of neat stuff, and you may be able to find a rare antique ir two.

resp.text: Thank you for the great review, we are glad you enjoyed your visit!! Hope to see you again!!

name: Chris Merz
text: Great little art and antique shop. A lot of unique stuff.

resp.text: Thanks for the great review,  Chris!!

name: Bobby Gilly
text: I've been to all sorts of stores/markets but nothing like Coastal Magpie; it's a unique shop that is very interesting to browse. I went back 3 times in a week and saw something new everytime.

resp.text:
Thank you for the great review, Bobby!!
We're glad you enjoyed your visits!!!

name: T Boharic
text: Traveled all around the coast of MS, up to Mobile AL, and this consignment shop was one of only 2 places I would recommend for their prices and quality in that entire area!

name: Allen Williams
text: Great selection of vintage industrial pieces.

name: Terry Emmons
text: I love to go here.  Always something new to see and they tell where it came from.

resp.text: Thanks for the great review, Terry!!!
